name: crispe-commit-composer-plugin
description: Use when asked to commit changes, save work to git, check in code, create a commit, or ship the current changes -- e.g. commit this / let's commit / save this to git / create a commit for X. 支持中文触发，如提交代码、提交这些改动、帮我commit等同类表达。Does not trigger on questions about commit history (e.g. what does this commit do, show me the last commit). Groups the working tree into logically ordered, size-capped commits (code -> test -> doc) under one stable "[feature]: summary" format per branch, verifies the build before committing code when detected, and keeps a safety backup so a mid-sequence failure can be rolled back without losing work.
